summary: Read a binary tree that is not empty. Every node holds a signed integer inside the 32-bit range. Starting at the root and moving downward one depth at a time, compute the mean of all values stored on that depth. Write those means from the top depth to the bottom depth. If a depth contains only one node, the mean is that node's own value.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
